purpose: Correct the reset-bootstrap inline-data boundaries from the actual 68000 post-increment sequence and isolate the only remaining unconsumed tail.

copy.setup: The 24-byte VDP-register loop advances A5 from 0x000002C2 to 0x000002DA; the preceding move.l consumes 0x000002DA-0x000002DD, leaving A5 at 0x000002DE for the 38-byte DBF copy loop.

consumers: Two move.l (A5)+ operations emit 0x00000304-0x0000030B through the VDP control pointer.
The four-byte move.b loop emits 0x0000030C-0x0000030F through the VDP data-base offset.

evidence: Exact 68000 instruction listing for System_ResetBootstrap at 0x0000021A.
A5 post-increment positions after the inline VDP-register loop, follow-up VDP command, copy loop, and post-copy hardware writes.
Exact ROM bytes and non-overlapping physical boundaries.
limitations: The copied payload's internal Z80 instruction/data interpretation remains unresolved.
The four-byte 0x00000310-0x00000313 tail has no recovered 68K consumer or internal format.
